title: Personalities
description: A list of AI personalities, including their preferred victory types and stat focuses.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name for the Personality, commonly is the Leader's name.

preferredVictoryType.description: Shown in the Civilopedia only; the AI pursues its grand strategy (AI.json)
preferredVictoryType.title: Preferred Victory Type

flavors.title: Flavors
flavors.description: The leader's AI flavors (Leader_Flavors of the original, 0-20) by flavor name, e.g. Offense, Culture, Spaceship. Missing flavors are 5.

diplomacyPersonality.title: Diplomacy personality
diplomacyPersonality.description: VictoryCompetitiveness, WonderCompetitiveness, MinorCivCompetitiveness, Boldness, DiploBalance, WarmongerHate, DenounceWillingness, DoFWillingness, Loyalty, Neediness, Forgiveness, Chattiness, Meanness. Missing values are 5.

majorCivApproachBiases.title: Major civ approach biases
majorCivApproachBiases.description: War, Hostile, Deceptive, Guarded, Afraid, Friendly, Neutral. Missing values are 5.

minorCivApproachBiases.title: Minor civ approach biases
minorCivApproachBiases.description: Ignore, Friendly, Protective, Conquest, Bully. Missing values are 5.
